newsitem.title: USA: QUALCOMM-Sony venture hits CDMA milestone.
newsitem.headline: QUALCOMM-Sony venture hits CDMA milestone.

text.p: QUALCOMM Personal Electronics, a venture of Qualcomm Inc and Sony Corp, said Monday it had shipped over one million digital phones with QUALCOMM's Code Division Multiple Access technology.
QUALCOMM Personal Electronics manufactures the QUALCOMM QCP-800 cellular and QCP-1900 PCS phones and the Sony CM-D500 cellular and CM-D600 PCS phones for worldwide distribution.

"Achieving this major delivery milestone...demonstrates the broad commercial appeal of CDMA digital phones for both cellular and PCS services," said Dr. Irwin Jacobs, chief executive officer of QUALCOMM.
